## Problem and result

Describe the trigger and resulting behavior.

## YouTrack task

Link the real task ID, owner, and acceptance criteria. If YouTrack is unavailable, identify the provisional backlog key and keep the task open.

## Validation

Record the commands and relevant scenario results. Distinguish local prototype checks from server acceptance.

## Review

List known limitations and any supervisor decision needed. Record the actual reviewer and outcome before merging; do not claim independent approval from self-checks or generated checklists.
